verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents first-party SDK reference APIs in Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby that drive the platform programmatically, such as creating and managing cron triggers and evaluating CEL expressions. However, no documented public REST/HTTP API was found: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. missing for 10: a published REST/OpenAPI spec for the public API, documented auth and endpoint coverage for driving all platform operations, independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
